azureLinkId.description: Link ID that identifies the Azure private endpoint connection.

comment.description: Human-readable string to associate with this private endpoint.

customerEndpointDNSName.description: Human-readable label to identify customer's VPC endpoint DNS name. If defined, you must also specify a value for `region`.

customerEndpointIPAddress.description: IP address used to connect to the Azure private endpoint.

endpointId.description: Unique 22-character alphanumeric string that identifies the private endpoint.

errorMessage.description: Error message describing a failure approving the private endpoint request.

provider.description: Human-readable label that identifies the cloud service provider. Atlas Data Lake supports Amazon Web Services only.

region.description: Human-readable label to identify the region of customer's VPC endpoint. If defined, you must also specify a value for `customerEndpointDNSName`.

status.description: Status of the private endpoint connection request.

type.description: Human-readable label that identifies the resource type associated with this private endpoint.
